name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: A historically grounded early-17th-century Ottoman Janissary firearms specialist, rendered as crisp 32x32 pixel art across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Lean, disciplined build; olive skin; thick mustache with clean-shaven chin per Janissary custom; white felt börk with a brass kaşıklık holder and plume. Wears a blue kaftan trimmed in burgundy at the collar and cuffs, a leather sash at the waist, loose şalvar trousers, simple leather boots. Carries a long matchlock musket with an ornately worked stock, a leather powder flask and priming horn crossed over the chest, and a curved yatağan tucked through the sash — representative of the corps at the height of its firearms expertise before the slide into 17th-century indiscipline. Clean, saturated period-appropriate color palette (whites, blues, burgundy, iron greys), bold black outlines, readable silhouette at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
